༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel gyi lag len bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel gyi lag len bzhugs/

sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs zur thig ni legs par btab/ /nyi ma'i sor gyis zlum por bskor/ /pad+ma dang ni thab kyi tshad/ /sum cha lte ba 'dab brgyad thig /phyi rol sor gnyis sor bzhis bskor/ /mchu dang kha khyer thig yin no/ /kha khyer mtha' nas phyi rol tu/ /khru do spangs pa rtsig pa nyid/ /sgo gcig byang du phyogs par bya/ /slob dpon la sogs gdan gsum ni/ /lho yi phyogs su dgod par bya/ /phyi ni thugs dkyil nyid dang mtshungs/ /rgyas pa'i thab la de nyis 'gyur/ /khru do gru bzhi thab nang tshad// zur thig steng du khru gang dang*/ /sor mo bcu gcig lhag bcas kyi/ /steng nas phyogs bzhir btab pas 'grub/ /slob dpon bden bral dbang ldan sgo/ /'di gnyis kha khyer phyir rdo rje/ /'phrin las thams cad pa la ni/ /gnyis te zhi dang rgyas pa'o/ /dang po thab dbyibs zhi rkyang 'dra/ /nang du phyed bskor bde gshegs gnas/ /de phyed bskor ba gtso bo'i gnas/ /tshangs zur bar la gsum gsum phye/ /de dag re re'ang gsum du phye/ /de la tshangs zur g.yas g.yon du/ /gnyis dang gcig dang gsum dang gcig /gnyis rnams sangs rgyas ka ba dang*/ /bum pa ka ba lha mo yi/ /gnas yin phyi nang rdo rje'i gdung*/ /sor re'i tshad dang ldan par bya/ /phyi mar tshon pa lha snam dang*/ /dpangs chung zheng yang dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /gnyis pa la yang des 'dre ste/ /nyis 'gyur gru bzhi'i dbyibs su bya/ /'di dag gnyis ka'ang thab kyi phyir/ /mchu la thab kyi brgyad cha dang*/ /re kha'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug cha/ /kha khyer bzhi cha de'i phyi ru/ /re kha sngar dang mtshungs pa nyid/ sgo dang rta bab nub tu phyogs/ /rwa ba'i nang gi shar phyogs su/ /slob dpon gdan ni dbus su ste/ /mchod yon sreg rdzas gdan g.yon g.yas/ /thab kyi dbyibs mtshungs pad+mas brgyan/ /kha khyer rdo rjes mtshan gdan dbus/

/sna tshogs rdo rje'am chos 'byung ngo*/ /'di dag ni nyer mkho cung zad brjod pa ste/ zhib par chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i nang gi mun sel dang*/ paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan dang*/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs thugs sras dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab las shes par bya'o/ /zhi ba rkyang pa la kha khyer dang gdan gsum dang dbus su pad+ma dang*/ rgyas pa rkyang pa la 'khor lo bkod nas 'dab ma la rigs bzhi yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan 'god cing*/ kha khyer gyi dpangs la pad 'dab dkar po bri/ las thams cad pa gnyis la thugs dkyil gyi/ mtshan ma ji lta ba ste/ dbus su rdo rje dang*/ kha khyer gyi phyi logs pad 'dab ljang khu'o/ /bsdus par na tshon spungs la sogs pas kyang rung tsam yin par mngon zhing*/ rtsig thab ma 'grub na bris thab bya zhing*/ de yang ma 'grub na thig tsam 'debs pa dang*/ shin tu bsdus na ra ba'i nang thig tshun chad gdab cing*/ de phan chad yid kyi bsam pa las dngos su ma bris kyang rung ba tsam yin te/ dgos pa'i don gyi gtso bo 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ cho ga gzhan dang rig pa mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /go skabs yangs shing long yod la rgyu tshogs 'dzom du rung ba'i skabs ni/ rgyud 'grel las rtsal du ston nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ thab kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa nyid bri dgos la/ phye mas 'bri ba'am/ chu tshon nyid kyis 'bri ba ji ltar byas kyang 'dra ste/ rdul tshon nyid kyi rnam grangs su 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad pa gnyis la kha khyer tshun chad thams cad ljang khu dang*/ zhi rgyas la dkar po'o/ /de la thog ma zhi ba rkyang ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ ku sha dang bcas pa'i mchod yon/ tsan dan dkar po'i dri chab/ me tog dkar po'i dri zhim pa/ bsil ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi mar gyi snang gsal/ 'o ma dang 'bras chan gyi zhal zas/ gzhan yang gos zung la sogs pa mchod rdzas dkar po dang*/ 'o ma can gyi yam shing mthe'u chung las mi phra zhing mthe bong las mi sbom la/

dkyus su mtho gang pa la lnga brgya bzhi bcu la brgya brgya re tshan du bcang ba dang*/ dur ba 'o mas sbags pa'i sreg rdzas/ gzhan yang sreg rdzas dkar po ji snyed pa dang*/ mar khu bud shing dgang blugs la sogs pa tshogs par byas shing*/ dus kyang zhi ba la karka ṭa dang seng ge'i khyim du bshad par dmigs gsal can gyi las nges par sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang lha mchod pa rgyun gyi nyams len la nges pa med do/ /thab tu bud shing yang bcug rang nyid chas gos dkar por bsgyur te/ thab khung gi lhor skyil krung gi 'dug nas/ rdo rje'i zhal dag pa nas brtsams/ yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma dang bdud sreg pa la sogs pa bgegs la phur bus gdab pa'i bar du/ sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro dang 'dra ba las/ bsrung ma drug cu'i bskyed pa sogs ma lcogs na/ khro bcu tsam gyi chog pas/ thugs dkyil sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung la/ phur btab kyi skabs su phur bu bcu dngos su 'god cing*/ n+ya gro ta'i phur bur mos pa tsam bya/ phur bu srung ba'i don du/ oṃ haṃ kro dha sogs brjod/ de dag thams cad la mchod bstod tsam byas la/ rang gis sgoms pa'i srung 'khor bdag nyid la bsdu/ bar 'dir bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba zhig sgom pa'ang yod la/ bsdu na bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lo skad cig gis gsal btab nas/ zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te sogs sho lo ka gsum 'don/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mchod yon bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes pa brgya tsam bzla/ ku sha'i rtse mos mchod yon nas blangs te/ rang dang thab dang yo byad thams cad la gtor/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa ces mang du brjod/ dkyil chog bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes lan mang du brjod cing sreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/

oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i me thab dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed/ dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad mtshan ma dgu dang bcas pa/ kha khyer la pad+ma'i 'phreng ba dang*/ kha khyer gyi dpangs la pad 'dab gyi 'phreng ba rtse mo 'og tu phyogs pa dang*/ phyi rol kyi sa gzhi la dur bas khyab pa/ de'i phyi rol gzhal med khang sgo gcig pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /thab kyi nang dang rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dang shel gyi bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis na ril pa spyi blug dang dung dkar 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ ral pa ser skya dang mig dmar ser/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'o/ / mchod yon sgrub zin nas 'di yan chad ci bde bar/ me sbar zhing bram ze'i khyim nas blangs te 'o ma can gyi shing las me sbar bar bshad pas de ltar mos so/ / zla ba rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin me lha de gnyis kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i dzaḥyig yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje lcags kyu 'od zer 'phro ba rnam par 'phros nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ e h+ya hi mahā bhū ta de ba ri ṣi dwe dza sat+ta ma gṛ hī dwa yur+dhaṃ mahā ra smin san+ni hi to bha wa badz+ra dhā ra adz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha'i drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /mtshon cha 'dzin pa 'od zer che// 'dir ni yang dag phan par mdzod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du'o swāhā/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par mos/ de ni sreg bya za ba mchod sbyin gyi me lha sha za'i me lha spyan 'dren pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng du mthe bos mnan pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ag+ni badz+ra satwa sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swāhā/

zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sdig pa thams cad sreg pa rdo rje'i me/ /rdo rje sems dpas sdig kun sregs shig sregs swāhā/ rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i ye shes gdod ma'i me lha de nyid dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang*/ lhan cig phyi rol tu byon te/ thab nang gi me lha dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes te de ni 'dod pa'i me'am mi bzad pa'i me zhes kyang bya ste/ de nyid spyan drangs pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra a na la sarba bhū tā na dz+wa la sarban bhasmi ku ru sarba dzā na duṣ+tan hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ rdo rje'i me ni 'byung po thams cad 'bar bar 'dod/ /thal bar mdzod cig skye bo gdug can thams cad do/ /hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas gza' bdun gyi bdag po rta bdun pa'i shing rta can gza' bdun gyi lce bdun dang ldan pa byon par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ lho'i me glog dang khyim bdag gi me nyi ma dang bsreg za'i me dkyus ma 'di yin/ gza' bdun gyi bdag po ni zla ba'i lce dang nyi ma'i lce dang spen pa'i lce dang pa sangs ky-i lce dang phur ba'i lce dang gza' lhag pa'i lce dang mig dmar gyi lce'o/ /de gsum kun rdzob me dang*/ don dam me ni ye shes gdod ma'i me rang gi snying ga nas spro ba de yin/ £© de ltar na khyim bdag gi me dang*/ sreg bya za ba'i me dang*/ bden pa ye shes kyi me kun tu dga' ba'i chos can/ sgrib pa med pa'i phung po la sogs pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i ngo bo'o/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ pra ba ra sata kā raṃ mahā rasmīn ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsa swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon bzed zhal du lan bdun la sogs par phul/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pratīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ka maṃ pratīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ rnam dag ye shes me dpung 'bar ba yis/

/phung po khams sogs sgrib pa'i bud shing rnams/ /skad cig nyid la bsreg cing gsol mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan me yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa rgyas pas bstod/ yam shing bsreg rdzas bsreg blug rnams zla ba'i lce la phul bas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad zag med kyi bde bas tshim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing mar gyis sbags pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i shing du mos la 'bul/ de bzhin du dur ba 'o mas sbags pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyang sngags de nyid kyi 'bul/ oṃ swāhā/ zhes pas kyang dgang blugs brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ las sngags sbyor tshul ni sngags re re bzhin sbyor ba'am/ bdun bdun tsam re la sbyor la/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tha ma kho na la sbyar kyang rung ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥbadag cag dpon slob dpon yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ oṃ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ dmigs bsal yod na bdag gam/ bsgrub bya'i ming dngos su 'jug cing*/ nad dang byur chags 'di lta bu zhes ming gsal bar brjod/ 'dis 'og ma kun la'ang rigs 'gres te/ sde tshan dang pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ oṃ hraṃ hriṃ hraḥswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing brgya rtsa dang sreg rdzas brgya rtsa gong bzhin phul/ oṃ swāhā/ zhes pas dgang blugs brgya rtsa ste/ sde tshan gnyis pa'o/ / oṃ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ aṃ āḥswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing dang bsreg rdzas 'bul/ dgang blugs yang gong bzhin 'bul te sde tshan gsum pa'o/ / oṃ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl aṃ aḥswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing dang bsreg rdzas 'bul/

bsreg blugs kyang gong bzhin 'bul te sde tshan bzhi pa'o/ / oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā haṃ hā swāhā/ zhes pas yam shing dang bsreg rdzas 'bul/ bsreg blugs kyang sngar bzhin 'bul te sde tshan lnga pa'o/ /de ltar na/ sde tshan lnga po so sor/ yam shing ni brgya brgyad nges par 'bul dgos la/ bsreg rdzas dang dgang blugs ni de tsam ma 'byor na ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyang dur ba 'o mas sbags pa zhi ba la gtso bo yin mod kyi/ dge ba'i las la 'os pa'i bsreg rdzas gzhan ji ltar 'os pa phul yang mi 'gal zhing legs pa yin no zhes pa ni dam pa rnams kyi man ngag go /de bzhin du bsdus par na yam shing lnga brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i rjes su/ sngags tshan lnga po sdom pa la bsreg rdzas brgya rtsa tsam dang*/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi sngags kyi dgang blugs kyang de tsam 'bul zhing*/ spros pa la dga' na sde tshan re re'i mthar/ gong bzhin mchod pa bstod kyang bya'o// de bzhin du me lha la gtor ma 'bul ba yang ste/ de dag kyang gnas skabs ci rigs par lag len la gdab par bya ba yin te bla ma'i ngag go /skabs 'dir ni nges par gong bzhin mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa 'chibs/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghan+dhe bsnams/ /rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/

/'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchog sbyin rdo rjai mchog khyod 'dud/ / sogs 'dud nyi shu dang*/ spro na/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med sogs kyang bya/ gling rnams mun pas khebs pa sel mdzad cing*/ /rtsi shing me tog 'bras sogs smin mdzad nas/ /'gro mang nyer 'tsho'i brten du gang gyur pa/ /gza' bdun bdag po khyim bdag me la 'dud// ces bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥmahā rasmi sa pa ri wa ra bh+yaḥ i dam ba ling gan+dhaṃ sogs srung ma drug cu'i gtor sngags sbyar ba'i lan gsum 'bul ba'am/ yang na gong gi spyan 'dren gyi sngags gsum po re re'i mthar/ gtor sngags sbyar na'ang legs par 'gyur ro/ /srung ma drug cu sogs yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor ma 'bul na yang skabs 'dir 'bul lo/ /de nas slob mas mchod yon gyi snod bzung*/ slob dpon gyis zan dang chu thogs nas phyi rol tu song ste/ oṃ bhū ra bhu baḥswāhā/ na mo de be bh+yaḥ swā sti pra dza bh+yaḥ swāhā rā dza bh+yaḥ swādha bi tri bh+yaḥ a laṃ bhū te bh+yaḥ ba ṣa ḍa in+d+ra ya/

zhes pa dang*/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ces sogs nas bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod nas phyi rol tu gtor/ rang la bsangs gtor dang nye reg byas nas/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ kā ya waka tsit+ta swa bhā wa shud+dhe swāhā/ zhes pas me la ku shas bsangs gtor bya/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ / sogs bzod par gsol/ srid zhi mnyam nyid chen po yi/ /me lha 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad la// dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ / ces sogs yid la 'dod pa'i don thams cad gsol ba btab ste/ oṃ dzaḥgats+tsha gats+tsha mahā rasmi swa s+tha naṃ saṃ trib to ho/ pu na ra ga mi ṣ+ya si/ de bā s+ya/ ya da ā hā na yā mi swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥ gshegs shig gshegs shig 'od zer che/ /tshims nas rang gi gnas su'o/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /lha 'dir gang tshe spyan drangs na'o/ /swāhā/ zhes pas dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig ye shes kyi me rang gi snying gar thim/ sha za'i me dang khyim bdag gi me yang rang rang gi gnas su gshegs/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs spyi dang 'dra*/ me rang bzhin kyi zhi ba na thal bas chu dang skam la gnas pa'i sems can la phan gdags par bya'o/ /rgyas pa kho na'i las kyang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ rgyas pa rkyang ba'i sbyin sreg la ni/ zho dang 'bras chan gyi zhal zas dang*/ 'bras so ba mon sran/ tsan dan dkar po/ sran dkar nar mo/ til nag la sogs pa 'bru lnga tshan cig mar la sbags pa'i bsreg rdzas dang*/ a shwad tha'i phur bu dang*/ 'khrig pa dang bu mo'i khyim du dang*/ me lha'i phyag g.yas na 'khor lo dang mu tig gi 'phreng ba/ g.yon na pad+ma dang spyi blugs dang nyi ma rnam par dag pa dang*/ rdo rje'i skyil krung tu bzhugs pa dang*/ me thab gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru do dang*/ dpangs su khru gang ba dang*/

nyi ma'i lce la phul bar bsam/ yam shing dang bsreg rdzas dgang blugs 'bul ba'i sngags la/ na maḥ 'i mtha' can dang*/ spel tshig gi skabs/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ dpal dang 'byor pa dang tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs dang dbang thang puṣ+tiṃ ku ru/ zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /de bzhin du zhi ba las thams cad pa ni zhi pa dang 'dra la/ rgyas pa las thams cad pa ni rgyas pa dang 'dra ba las/ thab bskyed pa'i skabs su me thab ljang khu byed pa dang*/ re kha'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi bar du kha khyer dang bcas pa/ thab kyi dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan ma lha'i gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ me lha ljang khu bzhad pa'i zhal/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan can no/ /brgyan dang gos dmar ser can/ zhi ba la sgra gcan dang*/ rgyas pa la dus me rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes pa dang thab kyi phyi rol tu ku sha 'graims pa rnams khyad par ro/ /gzhan yang bsad pa la thab khung gzhi'i rnam pa khru phyed pa dang*/ bskrad pa la zur lnga pa khru gang ba dang*/ dbang la zur gsum sor nyi shu pa dang*/ dgug pa la zur bdun sor bzhi bcu pa dang*/ rmongs pa la zur drug sor sum cu pa dang*/ rengs pa la zur brgyad sor drug cu pa dang*/ de dag so so la yang mchod yon gyi snod dang*/ mchod yon dang*/ nyer spyod dang*/ phur bu dang*/ thab kyi mtshan ma dang*/ kha khyer gyi dpangs kyi mtshan ma dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu 'gram pa dang*/ phyogs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ dus dang*/ 'dug stangs dang*/ me lha dang*/ dus lce dang*/ sngags kyi mtha' dang spel tshigs la sogs pa re re bzhin tha dad du yod pa rnams/ so sor nges par bya dgos te/ mtha' dag nang gi mun sel las rtogs par bya zhing*/ blo gros chen po rnams kyis rgyud 'grel chen po las kyang ngo*/ /'dir sbyin bsreg gzhan gyi lugs ltar/

me lha'i thugs ka sogs su dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni mi dgos kyang*/ bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i sde tshan lnga po la/ lha so so'i ngo bor mos pa dgos sam snyam na 'di yang mtha' gcig tu mi dgos te/ dbyangs lnga ring thung dang*/ yon tan dang*/ 'phel ba dang*/ ya ṇa ra bsgyur ba ring thung rnams dag sbyor gyi khyad par gzhan mang po la ltos pa dang*/ las dang dngos grub kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa 'grub pa'i dgos don mang po dbang gi yin gyi/ thugs dkyil gyi lha'i sa bon kho nar dmigs pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ye shes kyi me lha nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ spros pa gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ 'on te bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ rang gi mos pa'i khyad par gyis/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga 'dir sbyor ba dang*/ me lha'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa sogs kyang nan gyi byed na 'dir ci zhig 'gog des na 'od kyi snye ma dang*/ rgyud 'dir gsungs pa'i cho ga sbrags ma byed par spro na/ phyis kyi dus 'khor ba mang pos mdzad cing*/ khyad par bka' srol 'di la yang*/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ de nyid kyi thugs sras rnams kyis mdzad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa dpal dus gyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel gyi lag len zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sgrub gnas chen po jo nang du smras pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel gyi lag len bzhugs/ -PAGE 238--PAGE 229--PAGE 228- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
